Alger, 7 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 7, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — SOLTIC Algeria and KEYSTONE organized a workshop in Algiers to address the challenges of digital security, privileged access management, and regulatory compliance. The event brought together experts and industry stakeholders around concrete solutions to strengthen the protection of information systems.
Un événement dédié à la cybersécurité et: An event dedicated to cybersecurity and regulatory challenges in Algeria
Le workshop organisé par SOLTIC Algérie: The workshop organized by SOLTIC Algeria and KEYSTONE in Algiers is part of a drive to respond to the growing concerns of Algerian organizations regarding digital security. Faced with a multiplication of cyber threats and the constant evolution of regulatory frameworks, the two partners highlighted tailored solutions to secure IT environments.
Les discussions ont porté sur trois axes: Discussions focused on three major areas: data protection, privileged access management (PAM), and regulatory compliance. These themes, identified as priorities by companies, reflect an increased awareness of the risks associated with attacks targeting administrator accounts or critical systems.
L’événement a permis d’échanger sur des: The event provided an opportunity to discuss feedback and identify best practices to strengthen the resilience of structures against cyberattacks. The organizers emphasized the quality of the exchanges, marking a strong interest from participants in tailor-made approaches.

Au-delà des échanges théoriques, SOLTIC: Beyond theoretical discussions, SOLTIC Algeria presented a personalized support approach for organizations. The company offers to assess the current protection level of structures and identify their specific needs, thus avoiding generic solutions. This approach responds to a growing demand for adapted digital security, where each company must define its own priorities.
